title: Concept: Container registry catalogue in a response
description: A Docker registry catalogue listing repository names in a response gives every reader of that response the same information the bank holds internally: The catalogue enumerates every image the registry holds, including internal service names and the images that run production, which is the reconnaissance step before pulling layers or probing tags.
applicability: Image names map directly to services, and public pulls expose application code and embedded credentials.
risk: A registry catalogue is an inventory of the organisation's software; it is not public information.
